Every reconstruction of production relations in history has emerged from the collision between the bottlenecks of old organizational forms and the power of new technologies. Today, with the widespread adoption of infrastructure like Agent and OpenClaw, super entrepreneurs are presented with a natural opportunity to drive innovation and transformation based on AI technology. excerpt_i18n.en: The e-commerce version of "Wukong" is here! Recently, Alibaba officially launched the world's first enterprise-level AI-native work platform—"Wukong." After the merchant confirms the update with one click, the AI Agent will automatically execute "material creation → updating."

items.title: 计算所程学旗团队：随机剪枝 AI 攻击策略，让对抗样本更具「通用攻击力」丨CVPR 2026

For instance, in autonomous driving systems, visual models are required to recognize road signs and pedestrians; in intelligent security systems, facial recognition models are used for identity verification; in medical image analysis, deep learning models can assist doctors in identifying disease features. However, recent studies have consistently shown that these high-performance models still have significant security vulnerabilities. Among these, the adversarial example problem is considered one of the most critical security challenges facing deep learning systems. For example, by adding imperceptibly small perturbations to an image of a traffic sign, an autonomous driving system might misclassify a "speed limit sign" as a "stop sign"; in facial recognition systems, adding subtle noise to an image could cause the model to misidentify one person as another. These minor input changes can lead to completely erroneous predictions by the model, revealing not only the fragility of deep neural networks at decision boundaries but also posing serious challenges to the security of real-world systems.
